name: director-open
description: A local-first reel studio that humans and AI agents can both drive — your media never leaves the browser.

scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n web,worker -c blue,green "vite --port 5190 --strictPort" "wrangler dev --port 8790 --local"
scripts.build:app: vite build && pnpm --filter director-mcp build && pnpm --filter director-adobe build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:production && pnpm deploy:preflight && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm build:production && pnpm deploy:preflight && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && pnpm --filter director-mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter director-adobe typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm --filter director-mcp test && pnpm --filter director-adobe test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
